coordinates: body frame of the tracked mesh lib_teapot.obj (identity transform)
schema: sim frames.json (points/axes/quantities); up/front/lateral axes define the canonical frame the hand arm plans in

spout_tip.comment: calibrate_frames_from_mesh (sim) in the canonical frame, mapped to body; centroid of the 0.1% extremal vertices along pour_axis

up_axis.comment: canonical up (the input canonical.json's table normal)

pour_axis.comment: calibrate_frames_from_mesh (sim) in the canonical frame, mapped to body; horizontal spout direction

tilt_axis.comment: up_axis x pour_axis, positive tips the spout down

canonical.convention: columns [x=front, y=up x front, z=up] in the body frame
